answer: The multi-task learning setup uses a shared-private model architecture: a shared-private feature extractor whose "shared" part is a transformer encoder used to encode inputs of both tasks (leveraging its long-range dependencies and parallelism), combined with task-specific "private" parts and a selected sharing layer (attention/gate-based) for stance detection and fake news detection [8] [9] [11].
